gaps.gap_id: A3 — accessor-convention basis published only inside details->'trace'[*].basis (and: is a differential storage-slot comparison the real fix?)
gaps.real:
YES, exact to the row — with two corrections that change the recommendation.

(1) Query: `function_principals fp JOIN effective_functions JOIN contracts, LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(fp.details->'trace') st WHERE st ? 'basis'`, grouped by protocol / basis / membership_quality / confidence → a single group: **33 rows, protocol_id=1, basis='internal_accessor_convention', membership_quality='exact', confidence='enumerable'**. `slot_name_keyword` = **0 rows** (the register names it beside the other; it is unrealized on this corpus). All 33 carry both `authority_getter_basis` and `live_getter_resolution` steps — the register's "all 33 also carry live_getter_resolution" is confirmed. All 33 are `resolved_type='safe'`.

(2) The 33 rows collapse to **2 distinct principals and 3 runtime addresses**: 0xa000244b4a36d57ea1ecb39b5f02f255e4c8cd52 via `owner()` (0x8da5cb5b) on CumulativeMerkleDrop @ 0x6db24ee656843e3fe03eb8762a54d86186ba6b64 — 6 functions; and 0xf46d3734564ef9a5a16fc3b1216831a28f78e2b5 via `governor()` (0x0c340a24) on LRTSquaredAdmin (21 fns) + LRTSquaredCore (3 fns) @ 0x8f08b70456eb22f6109f57b8fafe862ed28e6040, and PriceProvider (3 fns) @ 0x2b90103cdc9bba6c0dbcaaf961f0b5b1920f19e3.

(3) Pinned at block 25643300: `owner()` / `governor()` return **exactly the published principals, 3/3**. The internal accessors `_owner()` / `_governor()` all **REVERT**, confirming the de-underscore fallback is the only reachable read.

(4) File:line verified — `_AUTHORITY_GETTER_BASENAMES` at predicate_evaluator.py:**775** (exact), `_public_getter_selector_for_internal_accessor` at :**971**-998 (exact).

CORRECTION A — the basis string CONFLATES two mechanisms of different strength. predicate_evaluator.py:1452 labels BOTH `_public_getter_selector_for_internal_accessor` (the de-underscore NAME convention, :971-998) and `_oz_v5_namespaced_authority_selector` (an exact accessor-NAME match anchored to the ERC-7201 standard, :1001+) as `internal_accessor_convention`. Per the latter helper's own docstring the CumulativeMerkleDrop 6 are the OZ-v5 arm; the other 27 are the free convention. So a consumer that dutifully reads `basis` **still cannot separate the standard-anchored match from the 3-name convention**.

CORRECTION B — the basis is NOT withheld from the consumer. `services/aggregations/company_overview.py:553-572` forwards `FunctionPrincipal.details` **whole** for `resolved_type in (safe, timelock, eoa, proxy_admin)`, so `details.trace[*].basis` reaches the client on all 33. But `grep -rn basis site/src` finds **zero** reads, and `membership_quality` / `confidence` **from function_principals.details** are read nowhere in `site/src` either (the only `membership_quality` reads are on `capability_expr`, protocolScore.js:130 / guardSummary.js:74). The sole consumer that does read basis is `scoring_prototype/scorer_v3.py:600, 668`. So today the over-strength is on the wire and in any future scorer — **not in a currently rendered number**. The defect is placement plus non-consumption, not availability, and the fix must be framed that way.
gaps.fixable:
YES for the basis publication — the fact is already at the write point.

• `services/resolution/predicate_evaluator.py:963-965` (inside `_resolve_authority_via_getters`) already appends `{"step":"authority_getter_basis", "basis": …, "selector": …}` to `live.trace`. Two in-scope changes: (1) **split the label** so the OZ-v5 arm gets its own value — both call sites (`:1343` with `bases=["auto_getter","internal_accessor_convention","slot_name_keyword"]` and `:1452-1456` with `candidate_basis`) already hold the discriminating information, namely which helper produced the selector; (2) at the point the capability is projected onto the principal, **hoist the winning basis to a top-level `details.authority_basis`** beside `membership_quality` / `confidence`, so no consumer can read the strength fields without seeing the basis.

• The DIFFERENTIAL is NOT in scope. predicate_evaluator.py:755-757's own comment states it: "The slot's own value is not on the operand (provenance carries only the identifier for a `state_variable` source), so there is nothing here to cross-check the getter's return against." At :1452 the operand is a `view_call` of an **internal function**, so there is not even a state variable to look a slot up for. Building it needs a NEW static-stage field (the storage slot of the variable the internal accessor returns) and therefore a full re-analysis run.
gaps.provable:
• Basis publication — **PROVABLE**. It is re-publication of a fact the producer already computed and already writes into `trace`, byte-for-byte, with the two arms separated by which helper fired (a compiler/AST-level distinction, not a name guess). Nothing is inferred.

• Differential storage-slot comparison — **NOT PROVABLE as a general fix on this corpus, and I recommend AGAINST it as the primary fix.** Measured: brute-force `eth_getStorageAt` over slots 0..47 on each runtime address at block 25643300, looking for the published principal, finds the value in **NO sequential slot** on CumulativeMerkleDrop @ 0x6db24ee6 (ERC-7201 namespace) and **NO sequential slot** on PriceProvider @ 0x2b90103c, and in **TWO slots (7 and 14)** on LRTSquared @ 0x8f08b704. So a slot-scan differential is (a) **unrunnable on 2 of 3** addresses and (b) **non-identifying on the third** — it would "corroborate" the convention against either of two slots and could not refute a wrong one. A check that is unrunnable on 2/3 and non-identifying on 1/3 is not a witness; adopting it would publish a corroboration the reads do not establish. Note also that the 3/3 getter agreement I measured is exactly the tautology the differential was meant to break: the published principal IS the getter's return, so agreement is guaranteed by construction.
  A differential IS provable **in principle** via a compiler-derived fact — Slither resolving the internal accessor's return expression to a declared variable, then `cu.storage_layout_of` (the same machinery `one_shot.py:301+` uses) or the ERC-7201 constant — but that is a new upstream field, a full re-analysis, and it must additionally handle namespaced/assembly-slot backings for 2 of these 3 contracts. Treat it as a **separate upstream enhancement carrying its own witness**, never as a substitute for publishing the basis.

• Explicitly rejected as not provable: separating a correct accessor from a wrong one by name suffix, or by "the values happen to agree today".

RECOMMENDATION: publish the basis (split into two labels) and have the consumer demote it. Do not adopt the slot differential now.
gaps.proposed_witness: RECOMMENDED (the provable one): `function_principals.details` gains a **top-level `authority_basis`** beside `membership_quality` / `confidence`, and the capability trace step's label is split, with an explicit strength order: `abi_auto_getter` (the compiler's ABI rule) > `standard_namespaced_accessor` (ERC-7201 exact accessor-name match, keccak-anchored — the 6 CumulativeMerkleDrop rows) > `deunderscore_convention` (the 3-name convention — the 27 LRTSquared/PriceProvider rows) > `slot_name_keyword`; **absent key = `not_determined`, ranked as the weakest**. The consumer must read it and must not treat `exact` + `enumerable` as self-certifying — exactly what SCORING_INVARIANTS §E's third corollary now requires. The co-witness that already exists is cited rather than assumed: all 33 rows also carry `live_getter_resolution`, so none rests on the convention alone; publish that as the corroboration and publish `accessor_slot_agreement: not_determined` for the residual. NOT recommended (unprovable here): a slot-scan differential — see `provable`.
gaps.honest_publication: For the residual the basis publication does NOT close — whether `_governor()` and `governor()` read the same storage — the honest publication is `not_determined`, explicitly. The row publishes: principal = 0xf46d3734… (a chain-verified `governor()` return at a stated block), `authority_basis = deunderscore_convention`, `accessor_slot_agreement = not_determined`. The co-witness that DOES exist must be cited rather than assumed: all 33 rows also carry `live_getter_resolution`, so none rests on the convention alone.
